title: What crosses the cut

data.source: Strong Markov property (Hunt 1956; Dynkin 1965) and Markov renewal theory (Levy 1954; Smith 1955; Pyke 1961); cited from memory. Simulated from Phoenix_Egg/CORE/MATHEMATICS.md section IV with its optional force, seeded.

prediction: The reading under test (the colloquy's wager H4): only the seed crosses, so given the cut point and the seed the earlier past adds nothing to the next gap (|z| < 3). The theorem says otherwise: the force at the cut crosses too (z > 10 for the last gap), and with cut point, force and seed all known the past adds nothing (|z| < 3, as for a re-drawn null).
baseline: The strong Markov property at a stopping time, and Markov renewal theory. Null: a next gap re-drawn from the three numbers alone, put through the same detector. Decoy: "the last gap is all that matters".
relation: the system is a Markov renewal process; the reading "only the seed crosses" conflicts with it whenever a force runs
status_kind: conflict (for the reading), special case (for the system)
status_line: CRR here is: a Markov renewal process whose state at a cut is three things (which cut point, the force, the seed); the reading "only the seed crosses" fails whenever a force is running.
why: With the three numbers known, nothing earlier helps, for the real next gap and for the re-drawn null alike. With only the cut point and the seed, the last gap shows through. Phoenix states R4, R2 and R5 as ASSUMPTION and the empty boundary as ONTOLOGY; it does not itself say the seed alone screens. That reading is the colloquy's H4, and in CRR as given with a running force it is false. It holds if there is no force, or if the force is re-drawn at each cut. MATHEMATICS.md never claims that the seed alone crosses. What fails is one reading, the colloquy's H4, inside one model; CRR's own file is not shown wrong or right. The owner can fairly reply that the force is external: the weather, not the runner. Then the seed is still the only thing of the system that crosses, and the force is the world's own memory. The mathematics does not decide between those ways of speaking. It decides only that the seed and the cut point are not enough to predict the next duration while the force runs.
